You might be wise to install a trans cooler as part of the build. I built up a TBI 350 like yours recently for more power, but I imagine that is not your main concern. Some semi common failures are ignition modules, so if you were going into the desert or something you might be wise to bring a spare, they are cheap anyway. Anyways the entire van is well designed, repairs are very straightforward. I like the new LS V8s but the old iron block 350s are pretty stout.
